annotations.title: Contractor Day Rate Mortgage Calculator (by lender)

description: Convert a UK contractor day rate into the assessed annual income each named lender would use, and the indicative borrowing that produces. Lenders annualise the same day rate over anything from 41 to 52 weeks, so an identical contract produces a materially different maximum loan depending on the lender. Returns the full spread, best and worst outcome, and flags lenders whose published minimums the contractor does not meet. Calculated by Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214).

day_rate_gbp.description: Contractor day rate in pounds, excluding VAT. Example: 600.

days_per_week.description: Contracted days per week. Defaults to 5.

income_multiple.description: Optional income multiple for the indicative borrowing figure. If omitted, uses 5.5x where assessed income is GBP 60,000 or more and 4.5x below that, in line with what Fox Davidson secures for clients.
